tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind panels. Text on it is `fg` or `fg-muted`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels: the results and calendar panels, tables, popovers. Text on it is `fg` or `fg-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Row hover and quiet fills inside a `surface` panel.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Ice: the highlighted table row (the runner or edition you came from) and record-holder cells. Text stays `fg`.

tokens.name: header
tokens.usage: Site header band: navy in light, near-black in dark so it still reads apart from `bg`. Always carries the white logo.

tokens.name: header-fg
tokens.usage: Active nav item and text on `header`.

tokens.name: header-muted
tokens.usage: Inactive nav items and the search placeholder on `header`.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Ink: body text, titles, big figures, and every heavy rule (`rule-heavy`, `rule-mid`). On `bg`, `surface`, `surface-muted` and `highlight`.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Steel: secondary text — clubs, weekdays, meta lines, labels above figures. On `bg`, `surface` and `surface-muted`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px hairline between table rows, panel outlines and podium dividers. Decorative, not a control border.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: 1px outline of inactive filter chips and secondary buttons; meets 3:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: DUV red for fills and marks: the active nav underline, primary buttons, solid WR/AR/NR markers, the DUV-Cup chip. Lifted slightly in dark. Not for small text in dark — use `brand-ink`.

tokens.name: brand-fg
tokens.usage: Text on a `brand` fill.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Red text: kickers above titles, the winner's rank, the year in a calendar title, DUV-Cup labels. On `bg` and `surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Runner and race links in tables and running text. On `bg`, `surface` and `highlight`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline, offset 2px, on every focusable element; at least 3:1 on `bg`, `surface` and `header`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status dot and word for complete results. Never colour alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Status dot and word for partial or provisional results.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, always with a word.

tokens.name: cr
tokens.usage: Course-record marker fill (text `cr-fg`).

tokens.name: cr-fg
tokens.usage: Text on a `cr` fill.

tokens.name: pb
tokens.usage: Personal-best marker: outline and text only, no fill.

tokens.name: medal-gold
tokens.usage: Solid medal mark (IAU gold). A mark, never text; always beside a label.

tokens.name: medal-silver
tokens.usage: Solid medal mark (silver).

tokens.name: medal-bronze
tokens.usage: Solid medal mark (bronze).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: UPPERCASE. Home hero and section openers only; one per page.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: UPPERCASE. The h1 of race, runner, country and calendar pages; 40px on phones.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: UPPERCASE. h2 inside a page, above a heavy rule.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: Key facts and podium figures, tabular digits; the unit follows at 22px/600.

styles.name: rank
styles.usage: Two-digit rank in result tables; the winner's in `brand-ink`.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: UPPERCASE, `brand-ink`. The line above a page title.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: UPPERCASE. Table heads, fact labels, filter chips (16px/600 there), tags.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Results, rankings and records from ultramarathons worldwide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Search a runner or follow a race through its editions.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Table cells, meta lines, names under figures.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Second line under a race name, search placeholder.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Footnotes, swatch labels, popover small print.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a figure and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, chip gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Chip padding inline, header band padding block.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Stack gap inside a panel section.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a page header and the heavy rule; podium cell padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The grid gutter: 12-column gap, column gap in rows.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between nav items and logo in the header.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Page padding on desktop (16px phones, 24px tablets).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: panels, buttons, chips, inputs, markers. Swiss Grid is square.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Only the 6px status dot beside a results-status word.

borderWidth.note: Rules carry the hierarchy instead of boxes and shadows.

tokens.name: rule-heavy
tokens.usage: In `fg`: above a page's main content block (podium, calendar list) and under the board header.

tokens.name: rule-mid
tokens.usage: In `fg`: under table heads; in `brand`: the active nav underline.

tokens.name: rule-hair
tokens.usage: In `border`: between rows, around panels, between podium cells.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Content column cap.

tokens.name: grid-columns
tokens.usage: Columns on desktop; titles take 8, meta 4.

tokens.name: grid-gutter
tokens.usage: Column gap.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Site header band height.

meta.basis: Swiss Grid direction (light and dark) from the DUV Brand Directions canvas; colour roles and record/medal colours carried over from DUV Almanac (westis/duv-next).
